description: The Cook Islands Utilities Regulation Policy sets out proposed oversight of electricity, water and sewerage providers. The official page supplies the 2023 policy, annexes and Cabinet approval context. The provider is Ministry of Finance and Economic Management. Coverage: Coverage is the Cook Islands and the policy process through September 2023. The page describes a proposed bill; it does not establish the current enacted legal position. Access: The official policy page and document labels were read. No legal or policy document was downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Cabinet approval to prepare a bill does not mean the bill became law. Current legal force and quantitative regulatory parameters were not verified. For simulation it supplies documented institutional assumptions for utility-service and governance scenarios. Related resources: The CIIC reports cover utility organisations and performance; they are separate from this policy source.
